[Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/the_democratic_republic_of_the_congo_near_term_projection__fewsnet_ipc_shapefile_for_2022]
datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule throughout 2022 for the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Geographic boundaries and IPC phase classifications (representing food insecurity severity) were compiled into GeoJSON and KML formats with metadata including collection dates, scenarios, and classification scales. This dataset represents post-event/current-state food insecurity impact assessments.

sources.name: FEWS NET
sources.description: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) spatial data collected through regular enumerator surveys. IPC classifications represent acute food insecurity outcomes driven by underlying hazards including drought and conflict.
